'''Bear''' can refer to the following:

* Any of a variety of [[bear]]s, including the common [[black bear|black/brown bear]]s, [[white-faced bear]]s, or [[great black bear]]s.
* ''[[The Old Black Bear]]'' - one of the songs played by [[Rand]] while traveling from [[Whitebridge]] to [[Caemlyn]].
* [[Blue Bear (sign)]] - The House sigil of [[House Haevin]]
